description: List past print jobs with pagination, filters, and sort. Compact mode (default) drops gcodeAnalysis, filament breakdowns, and panel-only flags.

accepted_statuses.description: Filter by job status. Multiple values OR-matched.

archived_status.description: null (default): hide archived; archived: only archived; both: include archived

compact.description: Keep at default true. Returns minimal data tuned for AI context. Only set to false if you specifically need fields the compact view drops, and then pair with limit to keep the response small.

limit.description: Cap on results per page (1-100). Alias for page_size.

printer_groups.description: Only jobs from printers in these groups

printer_ids.description: Only jobs from these printer ids

sort_by.description: Sort by this field. Default: started date desc (newest first).

spool_id.description: Only jobs that used this filament spool

user_ids.description: Only jobs started by these users (requires VIEW_ALL_PRINT_HISTORY)

name: list_print_jobs
